feeds.title: Afrah Nasser's Blog
feeds.description: Diving into the journalism ocean since 2008, Yemeni blogger and freelance writer, Afrah Nasser has been telling the untold stories about Yemen and Ins and outs of Yemeni politics. Follow this blog to get more information.

feeds.title: Yemen Embassy in Kuala Lumpur

feeds.title: The Media Line » Yemen
feeds.description: The Media Line is a precious asset in Mideast journalism. It covers all sides of most issues, using language that is unemotional and crystal clear. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: MintPress News » Yemen
feeds.description: MintPress News is an independent watchdog journalism organization that provides issue-based original reporting, in-depth investigations, and thoughtful analysis of the most pressing topics facing our nation. Get more information about Yemen news by following this feed.

feeds.title: Public Works Project
feeds.description: The public works project (PWP) has been created in the context of Yemen's social safety net, aiming to mitigate the adverse effects of the economic reform program set in motion during 1995. Follow to get the latest articles from this feed in your inbox.

feeds.title: Yemen Webdate Blog
feeds.description: Yemen Webdate is the blog of the American Institute for Yemeni Studies (AIYS). The aim of the blog is to provide up-to-date information on the academic study of Yemen with a focus on its history and culture. Follow this blog for more updates.

feeds.title: Yemen Watch
feeds.description: We are a group of journalists and activists seeking to raise the cause of the Yemeni people and their daily suffering in this country. Bringing you the latest updates and news that are taking place in the nation. Follow this blog to get the latest news in the region of Yemen.

feeds.title: Arab News » Yemen
feeds.description: Established in 1975, the Saudi-based Arab News is the Middle East's newspaper of record and the biggest English language daily in the Kingdom. Follow this blog to get more news articles related to Yemen.

feeds.title: M.News World » Yemen
feeds.description: We cover the most important political, economic, social and other socially important events taking place in the world, updating the news feed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Follow to get more updates.
